newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bangkok Bank signs US$150 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Bangkok Bank signs US$150 mln FRCD.

text.p: Bangkok Bank has signed a US$150 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue, arranger and lead manager HSBC Markets said.

The notes have a final maturity of seven years but can be put on the fifth anniversary. They pay a margin of 18.75 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate and, with fees, an all-in return of 24 basis points to the top tier.
HSBC said the FRCD received wide support despite a recent downturn in the market.

Moody's Investors Service cut Thailand's short-term sovereign ceiling ratings to Prime 2 from Prime 1, and hence the ratings of Bangkok Bank and two other Thai banks, on September 3, right in the midst of the Bangkok Bank deal's syndication.
HSBC Markets held the largest share of the issue, with US$56.5 million.
Co-arrangers and lead managers, with US$11.5 million each, are IBJ Asia, Merrill Lynch International, J.P. Morgan Securities Asia, Sakura Finance Asia and Tokai Asia.

Co-lead managers are Yokohama Asia, with US$10 million, and Asahi Finance (Hong Kong), Banca Nazionale del Lavoro Singapore branch, Daiwa Securities (HK) and Bank Negara Indonesia Hong Kong branch, with US$5 million each.
Senior managers, with US$3 million each, are Die Erste and Morgan Stanley Asia.
